result.instructions: Tools for Captivate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many downloads did my podcast get in the last 28 days?"; "List my scheduled episodes and their publish dates."; "Which of my episodes has the most downloads of all time?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Captivate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run captivate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run captivate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run captivate_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. captivate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: captivate_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get a Captivate user profile by user id (the id shown in the dashboard API section). Captivate API: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: captivate_list_user_shows
tools.title: List a user's shows
tools.description: List the podcasts (shows) a user can access in any role. Good first call to find show ids. Captivate API: GET /users/{id}/shows.

tools.name: captivate_get_show
tools.title: Get a show
tools.description: Get a podcast show by id: title, description, categories, artwork, status and settings. Captivate API: GET /shows/{id}.

tools.name: captivate_get_show_feed
tools.title: Get a show RSS feed URL
tools.description: Get the public RSS feed URL of a show. Captivate API: GET /shows/{id}/feed.

annotations.title: Get a show RSS feed URL

tools.name: captivate_list_episodes
tools.title: List episodes of a show
tools.description: List the episodes of a show with their status, publish date, titles and shownotes, plus a total count. Captivate API: GET /shows/{id}/episodes.

tools.name: captivate_list_scheduled_episodes
tools.title: List scheduled episodes
tools.description: List the episodes of a show that are scheduled for a future publish date. Captivate API: GET /shows/{id}/episodes/scheduled.

tools.name: captivate_get_episode
tools.title: Get an episode
tools.description: Get the full record of one episode by id. Captivate API: GET /episodes/{id}.

tools.name: captivate_get_media
tools.title: Get a media file
tools.description: Get the record of one uploaded media (audio) file by id. Captivate API: GET /media/{id}.

tools.name: captivate_list_show_media
tools.title: List media of a show
tools.description: List the uploaded media files of a show (20 per page) with totalCount. Captivate API: GET /shows/{id}/media.

offset.description: Number of items to skip (default 0). The page size is 20.

tools.name: captivate_get_overview_analytics
tools.title: Podcast overview analytics
tools.description: Download analytics overview of a show for a date range, optionally with top episodes. Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/overview.

tools.name: captivate_get_episode_overview_analytics
tools.title: Episode overview analytics
tools.description: Download analytics overview of one episode for a date range. Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/overview/{episode}.

tools.name: captivate_get_average_analytics
tools.title: Podcast average downloads
tools.description: Average downloads per interval of a show (default 28-day intervals). Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/averages.

tools.name: captivate_get_total_analytics
tools.title: Podcast all-time downloads
tools.description: All-time download total of a show. Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/total.

tools.name: captivate_get_episode_total_analytics
tools.title: Episode all-time downloads
tools.description: All-time download total of one episode. Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/total/{episode}.

tools.name: captivate_get_monthly_analytics
tools.title: Podcast monthly downloads
tools.description: Month-by-month downloads of a show for the past 12 months. Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/monthly.

tools.name: captivate_get_episode_monthly_analytics
tools.title: Episode monthly downloads
tools.description: Month-by-month downloads of one episode. Captivate API: GET /insights/{show}/monthly/{episode}.

tools.name: captivate_update_episode
tools.title: Update an episode's text
tools.description: WRITE. Change the text fields of an existing episode (title, shownotes, summary, subtitle). Only the fields you pass are sent. It does not publish, delete or change media. Captivate API: PUT /episodes/{id}.
